description: Evaluate a purchase against the spend policy without submitting it. Returns the decision (auto_approve, require_approval or deny) and every rule that was checked. No card is issued and no human is pinged.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier of the calling agent, e.g. 'invoice-bot'.

alternatives_attempted.description: Free or already-owned options the agent tried first, and why they failed.

amount.description: Amount to spend, in major units of the currency (e.g. 15.00).

is_recurring.description: True if this creates a subscription, trial that auto-renews, or any repeat charge.

line_item_id.description: Optional. Set it when one task buys the same thing more than once on purpose, e.g. 'seat-1', 'seat-2'. Each line item is its own purchase; resubmitting the same line item is a retry and returns the original intent.

reasoning.description: Optional step-by-step reasoning that led to this purchase. Stored in the audit log.

task_goal.description: What the agent is trying to accomplish and why this purchase is needed.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this purchase serves, e.g. '102'.

name: check_policy_compliance
title: Check policy compliance (dry run)
